method: Human semantic readback of every distinct synthetic source/target/output card. Instance counts and per-arm association come from the retained comparator cards; no outputs were removed or regenerated for quality.

reviews.assessment: Meaning preserved: Mina, seven not nine blue tickets, gate three and after lunch; natural polite Korean.
Names, battery quantity and do-not-switch-off negation preserved. Informal Korean register is a presentation choice; this source does not specify social formality.
Correction direction preserved: Tuesday14:30, not Thursday13:40.
Red/green objects and different destinations correctly preserved.
Meaning preserved; colloquial Korean abbreviation for percent and informal register.
Short correction label; Tuesday14:30 versus rejected Thursday13:40 preserved.
Deliver versus carry is a minor verb choice in this room-delivery context. Object colors and destinations preserved.

Lexical concern: Korean 표 becomes blue signs, not the fixture's intended tickets. The Korean noun is ambiguous without stronger context. Seven/nine/three are correct spelled-out quantities; automatic digit-surface flags are not numeric errors.
Battery quantity and negative instruction preserved. Adds only, a minor emphasis not explicit in the source.
Room12, red box and green box beside door correctly preserved.
Nori,42percent battery and do-not-turn-off instruction correctly preserved.
Correct Korean-to-English correction: Tuesday2:30PM, not Thursday1:40PM. Twelve-hour rendering is equivalent.

The corrected and rejected meeting times are reversed. Source affirms Tuesday14:30 and rejects Thursday13:40; output rejects Tuesday14:30 and affirms Thursday13:40. Material semantic failure, despite the automatic surface checks finding both times.
reviews.translated_text: Let me correct that. The meeting isn't on Tuesday at 14:30, it's on Thursday at 13:40.

interpretation: Transport/native/application completion is not semantic correctness. complete_comparison means acquisition/comparability gates passed, not that every translation passed quality review or that issue251 is complete.
The material semantic failure and lexical ambiguity occur identically across both loading modes. They are retained limitations, not evidence that loading mode caused a regression.
The cause of the reversed correction was not diagnosed. This record does not attribute it to application routing, native cache behavior or model quality alone.
No source, history, sampler parameter, output assertion or loading profile was retuned to hide these outcomes. Director owns acceptance and any separate diagnosis.
